hypothesis.h0: A verifier declared compositional yields the same verdict on an integration candidate containing the component it passed on.
hypothesis.h1: An inherited pass co-occurs with an integration failure at a rate above 1%.

falsification: The compositional flag is removed from a verifier whose inherited pass co-occurs with an integration failure at any rate above 1%, with the stratified bootstrap 95% interval reported. Until this experiment runs, the safe configuration is compositional = false everywhere, which costs one verifier run per batch member.

conditions.description: verifier verdict inherited under a compositional = true manifest entry
verifier re-executed on the integration candidate; the baseline

workloads: at least 200 admitted integration candidates carrying at least one compositional manifest entry
population.sampling: single frozen corpus of integration episodes; every candidate is scored under both conditions

effect_size.measure: exact proportion of inherited passes co-occurring with an integration failure
effect_size.unit: rate above which the compositional flag is removed

exclusion_rule: An integration episode is excluded when the verifier could not execute in the rerun condition, or when the integration failure is attributed by the batch conflict-attribution rule to a member other than the one carrying the inherited pass. Excluded episodes are retained with their reason.

environment.source_commit: pinned at run time; the exact commit is recorded in each run.json

threats: attribution of an integration failure to the wrong batch member; the conflict-attribution rule of docs/algorithms/evidence-and-admission.md is applied before scoring
